name: p_mdotAir
description: Combustion-air mass flow. Baseline until measured on the lab burner; bracket 0.035-0.055 (v9 note RC.3)

name: p_mdotFuel
description: Fuel mass flow (nominal 2.25 US gal/h); replace by the measured value

name: p_Text
description: Radiation temperature of the open (black) boundaries and the cell

name: p_lTurbIn
description: Inlet turbulence length scale (~0.07 D of the draft tube)

name: p_baseSize
description: Mesh base size: the single driver of the GCI levels (all controls relative to it)

name: p_meshLevel
description: Mesh level for records only (1 coarse, 2 medium, 3 fine)

name: p_yFirst
description: First-cell height on T_yplus1 walls; adjust until y+ <~ 1 is reported

name: p_nPrism
description: Number of prism layers on T_yplus1 walls

name: p_dt
description: Time step (Courant ~1-3 in the head slots and shear layers)

name: p_tAvgStart
description: Start of statistics (discard >= 1-2 s after the last model switch)

name: p_tEnd
description: End time (expression); used by the stopping criterion

name: p_radUpdate
description: Radiation update interval in steps (~0.5-1 ms of physical time)

name: p_smd
description: Sauter mean diameter (until measured on the lab nozzle)

name: p_rrX
description: Rosin-Rammler characteristic size X = SMD*Gamma(1-1/n) (48 um for 38 um, n 3.5). This, not the SMD, is the code input

name: p_wsggPath
description: WSGG optical path length (flame scale, sweep 0.1-0.3)

name: p_standoff
description: Calibration / specimen stand-off from the cone exit

name: p_mdotWaterCal
description: Copper-tube water flow: use the lab's value (Handbook formula implies ~0.035)

name: p_couplingInterval
description: Quasi-steady re-coupling interval (5-10 s early, 30-120 s later)
